ValidationRule.description: VR-ACC-09: Prevents creating Quotes on Accounts with a credit block. System Administrators and Revenue Ops users are exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Credit_Block__c, NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT($Profile.Name = "Revenue Ops") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This account has a credit block. Contact Finance to resolve before creating Quotes.
